item.title: Switch 2 Controversy Defines Doug Bowser’s Retirement as Nintendo of America President With Gamers Mocking His Infamous 'Go Buy a Switch One' Quote
item.description: When Nintendo of America confirmed that its president and chief operating officer, Doug Bowser, would step down at the end of 2025, the announcement was delivered with the sort of corporate formality that typically accompanies leadership changes.
